notes.title: Walkthrough now available!
notes.notes:
Hello! Happy winter!

As I mentioned in the last update, I have created a walkthrough in case you get stuck or want some help getting all the endings. The walkthrough is available to everyone who has the game in a new folder called 'extra'. [b]Do NOT look at the extra content if you don't want spoilers![/b]

To access your game files, right click on the game name in your library and then navigate to 'manage' and then 'browse local files'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310910/4ae5240daa7c396c0b6ff79191b63da9666111cd.png[/img]

As a bonus, just for fun I have also included a character sheet. It includes new images of all the characters in the game! Both the walkthrough and the character sheet are pdf files and they are both found in the 'extra' folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310910/9cf3abca6bb52dc29c851712380b03e762e3a530.png[/img]

Thanks again for playing Sapphic Space. I hope your New Year's is extra sparkly!

･°˖✧◝(⁰▿⁰)◜✧˖°.
Leaflet Games

notes.title: Gallery now available!
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you so much to everyone who has played and enjoyed Sapphic Space.

This small update adds a gallery to the main menu screen.

A little bot is watching you! It keeps track of what endings you have gotten.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310910/d8b7215a0e5623de8fbf3c5b382bb5089ea9ad21.png[/img]

Click on the bot to open the gallery. The bot will place the ending images here once you have seen them so that you can collect them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310910/11d2bed078214ad42a4cafab2096330ea947be0b.png[/img]

This update also contains some small fixes regarding typos and gameplay flow.

Keep an eye out because I am also working on an official walkthrough to help you achieve all the endings, in case you are getting stuck.

Thanks again for playing and hope you are having a happy autumn season!

(ꈍᴗꈍ)♡
Leaflet Games
